block.description: Automation API: API Backend for epilot Automation Workflows feature

actions.description: The actions (nodes) of the automation flow

schedule_id.description: Schedule Id which indicates the schedule of the actions inside the condition

id.description: The id of the action or trigger

repeatable_item_op.description: Whether to apply the operation to each item of the repeatable attribute

blame.description: The 360 user email that disabled the flow

disabled_at.description: When the flow was disabled. Not Null

disabled_by.description: Who disabled the flow (system or user). Not Null; must be one of ["system", "user"]

enabled.description: Whether the automation is enabled or not

flow_name.description: A descriptive name for the Automation

id.description: Stable identifier referenced by AutomationActionConfig.loop_id. Not Null

length.description: Maximum number of iterations. 0 / omitted = iterate the full resolved array.

source_path.description: Path resolved against the trigger entity to produce the array of iteration items. e.g. submission.steps[0]['Contracts']. Not Null

source_type.description: How source_path is interpreted. 'journey-multi-select' is the v1 source type (journey card block with multi-select). Future source types (e.g. 'previous-action-outputs', 'entity-relation') will be added here. Default: "journey-multi-select"; must be one of ["journey-multi-select", "previous-action-outputs", "entity-relation"]

loops.description: Loop scope definitions. Each loop has an id and a source_path resolved against the trigger entity at execution time. Actions referencing a loop's id via their loop_id property run once per item in the resolved array. Loop members must be contiguous in the actions array.

manifest.description: Source blueprint/manifest ID used when automation is created via blueprints.

count.description: Maximum number of executions per time window

window.description: ISO 8601 duration time window for the threshold

max_executions.description: Customized execution hot flow rate limit. Takes precedence over the default hot flow rate limit if specified.

protected.description: If true, automation is displayed in read-only mode in the UI to discourage changes

system_flow.description: Determines if the flow is a system generated flow

schema.description: Which entity type can this automation be triggered from

journey_id.description: When Journeys are linked to Workflows V2 as Journey Automations, this field will contain the ID of the Journey

direction.description: Whether the trigger should be matched against only inbound, outbound emails or both. Not Null; must be one of ["INBOUND", "OUTBOUND", "BOTH"]

shared_inbox_ids.description: A list of shared inbox IDs that the email thread should be matched against.
